name: Tomo GTA VI Clipping (Clipping Nation)
campaign_url: Content Rewards: TOMO GTA VI Clipping (joined Nov 18); rules on Notion (Clipping Nation)
required_in_caption: Mention Tomo and @Tomovids, plus a CTA like 'Subscribe to Tomo on YouTube'
rules: Videos must feature Tomo and be sourced mainly from his GTA VI YouTube livestreams or his GTA VI videos.
CTA: every clip must mention Tomo and tell viewers where to watch more, e.g. 'subscribe to Tomo on YouTube'.
Platforms: TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts only; cross-posting to all three encouraged.

English only; audience at least 40% Tier 1 (USA, UK, Canada, Australia). At 2,000 views send a screenshot/recording of the country breakdown to the Discord support chat, or the video won't be approved.
Caption: use #tomovids and #gta6, and mention @Tomovids on screen or in the caption.
Captions must be readable without sound.
Likes must be visible on all clips (hidden likes are rejected).
Account must be in a related niche (gaming, GTA, streamers, clips).
Keep at least a 1% engagement rate.
Every clip must stay live for at least 30 days.
Original edits only: no stolen/reuploaded clips, no 1:1 copies, don't post the same or nearly identical clip more than 5 times.
No engagement bait: no misleading titles, fake context or clickbait thumbnails; never portray Tomo in a negative light.
No fake engagement (bought/botted views = permanent ban).
Submit the video link within 30 minutes of posting.
No low-effort content: no raw screen recordings, random moments or clips with no clear purpose; properly edited and engaging.
Structure: hook in the first 2 seconds, one clear funny/crazy/surprising moment needing little context, CTA naming Tomo.
Priority: funny/chaotic moments and first reactions to GTA VI (features, cars, places, missions), stunts, chases, fails, interactions.
Payout: join Clipping Nation Whop + Discord, connect socials in Whop (Settings > Connected Accounts), submit within 30 min, send analytics at 2,000 views.
source_footage: youtube.com/@Tomovids: GTA VI livestreams (Live tab VODs) and GTA VI videos
notes: Joined Nov 18. Tomo streams GTA VI from launch day (Nov 19). Hook card + captions + end CTA 'Subscribe to Tomo on YouTube @Tomovids'. Owner must send analytics at 2,000 views per clip. Nov 19 scan: rate now $1.50/1K, $3.50 min (Content Rewards article); ~$127 used, 11 clippers on Nov 18.
engine_note: YouTube can't be downloaded from the cloud workspace (blocked), so this campaign uses Everygen's download_video + editor. Show the credit cost and get the owner's yes before each batch. Find new Tomo GTA VI streams/videos with the YouTube Data API (channel @Tomovids).
payout_setup: Owner joined the Clipping Nation Discord and connected socials in Whop (Nov 18).
